hook_text: 999 999 or 1 000 000? One trick settles every big-number comparison.
clip_script: To compare two whole numbers, first count the digits. A number with more digits is larger. If the digit counts are equal, compare digit by digit from the left, and the first place where the digits differ decides it. Compare 1 384 000 and 1 241 000: both have seven digits; the millions digits are both one; in the hundred thousands, three beats two. So 1 384 000 is greater than 1 241 000.
visual_style: Three city signs with populations; digits light up left to right until the first difference glows green; a 999 999 sign shrinks next to a 1 000 000 sign.
pacing: Count digits fast, slow down at the first differing digit, snap to the answer.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson for the three calculation shortcuts you are allowed to use.
